title.narrative: Strengthening the M&E system of the National Strategy for Growth and Reduction of Poverty

description.narrative: The objective of this project is to strengthen the capability of the Government of Uganda to track progress towards the achievement of outcomes of its Poverty Eradication Action Plan (PEAP). This will be done by assisting the Office of the Prime Minister (OPM), to implement the National Integrated Monitoring and Evaluation Strategy (NIMES), specifically focusing on improving the coordination, harmonization and alignment of existing monitoring and evaluation systems that form components of the M&E system to track PEAP outcomes. Component 1: Improving M&E Coordination and Addressing Data Gaps 1. Implementation plan for the PEAP M&E framework. 2. Coordination with UBOS and M&E working groups. 3. Framework for information flow between local, sectors and central information systems. Component 2: Strengthening Results-Based Management 4. Periodic PEAP Review Mechanism 5. Evaluation of PEAP policy actions and programs. Component 3: Strengthening M&E Capacity 6. Training sessions and workshops 7. Technical Support to Government Staff. Likely Outcomes of Project Activities 1. National and local M&E systems are coordinated and aligned to generate data necessary for measuring progress in achieving the PEAP outcomes; 2. Capacity at national and local level is strengthened to ensure the development and implementation of policy actions and programs to achieve targeted PEAP outcomes; 3. Robust PEAP implementation review mechanism in place. The objective of the Grant is to support the Recipient in: (i) strengthening its capacity for tracking progress made towards achieving outcomes of its Poverty Eradication Action Plan (PEAP); and (ii) implementation of the National Integrated Monitoring and Evaluation Strategy (NIMES).
